title: Minute Clinic Virtual Care Nurse Practitioner
description:
Job Title: Minute Clinic Virtual Care Nurse Practitioner
Job Location: Work at Home, Georgia, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time
Job Seniority Level:
We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
This is a full-time, remote position. Providers will work 32 hours/week, including every other weekend. Qualified candidates must hold a current, unrestricted license in GA, NC, SC, VA, NY, NJ, WV, CT, WI , or PA to meet minimum qualifications for this position. If hired, must be willing and able to obtain additional licensure.

The Minute Clinic Virtual Care Nurse Practitioner (Provider) delivers patient care services through a remote technology platform. You will work in collaboration with a dedicated team of professionals as you independently provide holistic, evidenced based care inclusive of accurate assessment, diagnosis, treatment, management of health problems, health counseling, and disposition planning for our patients ranging in age 18 months and above.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT:

• Dedicated virtual care providers must meet minimum requirements for remote care delivery, including: broadband connectivity, a quiet setting with a neutral background to conduct visits from, and the ability to uphold patient privacy per CVSH guidelines. Ability to hardwire into connection preferred.

• While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to interact with customers in a remote manner, site, write, operate the computer and phone, speak intelligibly, and hear patient responses.

• Specific vision abilities include the ability to view and read a computer screen and other electronic devices

Responsibilities:

• Provide holistic, evidenced based care inclusive of accurate assessment, diagnosis, treatment, management of health problems, health counseling, and disposition planning for our patients. This includes education and treatment for pregnancy prevention, STI Prevention and safer sex practices.

• Evaluate primary care, acute, chronically ill, and transitional care patients, in addition to providing healthcare education and counseling, and disposition planning for our patients ranging in age 18 months and above.

• Provide patient counseling; inclusive of pregnancy prevention, STI Prevention/safer sex practices, contraceptive care counseling and medication management

• Educate patients on health maintenance and respond to patient care inquiries

• Document all patient care within an EHR according to MinuteClinic policies and procedures

• Provide care and coordination of our patients with internal and external colleagues, including the broader patient centered medical home, ensuring the highest standard of care is provided for all patients.

• Effectively work within a patient care team, including fellow Providers, Collaborative Physicians, paraprofessionals, Pharmacists and other members of the health care team

• Work independently , prioritize and solve problems, take initiative, and advocate for their patients and their practice

Required Qualifications:

• Candidates must be currently licensed in one of the following states to be considered: GA, NC, SC, VA, NY, NJ, WV, CT, WI , or PA

• Minimum of two years of medically-relevant experience or equivalent

• Effective verbal, written, and electronic communication skills

• Outstanding organizational skills and ability to multi-task

• Initiative, problem solving ability, adaptability and flexibility

• Ability to work without direct supervision and practice autonomously

• Is proficient with information management and technology

title: Cryptography Firmware Engineer
description:
Overview
LMI is seeking an Cryptography Firmware Engineer to support the development of secure embedded systems for next-generation mesh networking products used by Department of Defense customers. This role focuses on implementing embedded cryptographic capabilities, integrating hardware security features, and developing secure key management solutions across LMI’s product portfolio.
The ideal candidate has experience with embedded firmware development and an interest in applied cryptography. You will help integrate the Nordic nRF54L Series AES-256 hardware accelerator , develop secure firmware features, and build a repeatable test environment to validate cryptographic functionality and fleet-wide key management processes.
U.S. citizenship is required. Candidates must be eligible to obtain a Secret security clearance. An active Secret clearance is preferred.
LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.
Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors, helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.
Responsibilities
Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain embedded firmware supporting secure communications and cryptographic functionality.

• Integrate and optimize use of the nRF54L Series AES-256 hardware accelerator within embedded firmware.

• Design, implement, and validate secure key management capabilities for embedded devices.

• Develop and maintain a cryptographic test laboratory to support verification of encryption, authentication, and key management processes.

• Create repeatable test procedures for device provisioning, key rotation, and fleet-wide cryptographic key updates.

• Collaborate with hardware, firmware, cybersecurity, and systems engineering teams to implement secure embedded architectures.

• Support hardware integration, firmware validation, and production readiness activities.

• Participate in design reviews and contribute to security architecture discussions.

• Document firmware designs, cryptographic workflows, and validation procedures.

• Support customer demonstrations, lab testing, and occasional field integration activities.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related STEM field.

•
3-6 years of embedded firmware development experience using C/C++ .

• Experience developing firmware for embedded microcontrollers.

• Basic understanding of applied cryptography, including AES encryption, secure key storage, and authentication.

• Familiarity with embedded hardware peripherals and communication interfaces such as SPI, UART, I2C, and GPIO.

• Experience debugging embedded systems using standard development tools.

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

• Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary engineering team.

• U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain a Secret security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Nordic Semiconductor nRF54 Series microcontrollers.

• Experience implementing hardware cryptographic accelerators or secure elements.

• Familiarity with secure boot, secure firmware updates, and device provisioning.

• Experience developing key management or certificate management solutions.

• Familiarity with FIPS 140-3 or other embedded security standards.

• Experience supporting DoD or government technology programs.

• Prowadzisz rozmowy z klientami, rozumiesz ich potrzeby i przekładasz je na konkretne rozwiązania

• Ma doświadczenie w pracy z klientem B2B (najlepiej klasy corporate)

• Swobodnie porusza się między światem biznesu i technologii

• Potrafi prowadzić rozmowy doradcze i budować wartość w procesie sprzedaży

• Ma doświadczenie w prezentacjach, demo i pracy z decydentami

• Rozumie procesy ofertowe (RFP/RFI) i potrafi tworzyć dopasowane propozycje

• Zna język angielski na poziomie min. B2

Warunki współpracy:

• współpracę w modelu B2B w oparciu na jasno określone cele i rezultaty

• wysoki poziom autonomii w sposobie realizacji usług

• możliwość świadczenia usług zdalnie oraz korzystania z biur Autenti w Warszawie i Krakowie

• udział w projektach o dużej skali i złożoności biznesowej, we współpracy z doświadczonymi zespołami produktowymi, technologicznymi i biznesowymi

• dostęp do narzędzi i systemów niezbędnych do realizacji usług

* Zgodnie z przepisami o jawności wynagrodzeń, kandydaci zostaną poinformowani o przedziale płacowym na pierwszym etapie procesu rekrutacji, przed zaproszeniem na rozmowę kwalifikacyjną.
Autenti to europejska platforma usług zaufania, która łączy ludzi i firmy w przestrzeni cyfrowej, zapewniając szybkość, wygodę i bezpieczeństwo. Wspieramy firmy w zarządzaniu dokumentami - od e-podpisów (Autenti eSign), przez weryfikację tożsamości (Autenti eID), po e-doręczenia i archiwizację (Autenti eDelivery, Autenti eDocument). Z naszych rozwiązań korzystają tysiące organizacji w całej Europie, w tym firmy z wymagających sektorów, takich jak bankowość czy ochrona zdrowia.

W Autenti wierzymy, że najlepsze rozwiązania powstają, kiedy działamy razem. Stawiamy na zaufanie, współpracę i szacunek, i staramy się tworzyć środowisko, w którym każdy głos ma znaczenie. Jednocześnie bezpieczeństwo i zgodność stanowią fundament naszych działań. Działając w oparciu o sprawdzone standardy i stale doskonaląc nasze praktyki, tworzymy rozwiązania, na których mogą polegać nasi klienci.

About Sandy Hook Promise  

Sandy Hook Promise (SHP) envisions a future where all children are free from school shootings and other acts of violence. As a national nonprofit organization, SHP’s mission is to educate and empower youth and adults to prevent violence in schools, homes, and communities. Creators of the lifesaving, evidence-informed Know the Signs prevention programs, SHP teaches the warning signs of someone who may be in crisis, socially isolated, or at-risk of hurting themselves or others and how to get help. SHP also advances school safety, youth mental health, and responsible gun ownership at the state and federal levels through nonpartisan policy and partnerships.

SHP is led by several family members whose loved ones were killed in the tragic mass shooting at Sandy Hook Elementary School on December 14, 2012. 

Commitment to Belonging, Community, Engagement, and Respect 

SHP strives to ensure its culture and work environment reflect the values of belonging, community, engagement and respect. We actively seek to understand and respond to the diverse perspectives and lived experiences of individuals across socioeconomic backgrounds, rural and urban communities, and diversity of thought, in addition to traditional protected categories. We are committed to ensuring that every SHP employee feels heard, valued, and a true sense of belonging. SHP encourages individuals who share our commitment to these core values and to our mission to apply.

title: Scrum Master / Risk Analyst
description:
Job Summary
Scrum Master / Risk Analyst
Client: Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Health Administration, Office of Clinical Informatics
Location: Remote, with occasional travel as required
Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain a VA Tier 1 / Public Trust background investigation
Employment Type: Full time, contingent on contract award
Position Summary
This position covers two jobs on one team. The Scrum Master side runs the team's sprints and Agile ceremonies, keeps work moving, and clears roadblocks. The Risk Analyst sidetracks risks to cost, schedule, and performance, keeps the risk register updated, and reports risk status to program leadership and the customer.
Most of the week is spent with the delivery team. The rest goes to collecting risk data from the program team, updating the register, and writing the risk sections of weekly and monthly reports.
Primary Responsibilities
W hat You Will Do: Scrum Master

• Run daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

• Coach the team on Scrum and SAFe practices.

• Find and clear roadblocks. Raise the ones the team cannot fix on its own.

• Support Planning Interval planning, including prep work, dependencies, and what the team commits to.

• Work with other teams on shared or dependent work.

• Track team metrics such as velocity, burndown, and how well the team meets commitments, and use them to improve.

• Keep the team focused and the workload manageable during busy periods.

• Keep the backlog, board, and tools up to date.

What You Will Do: Risk Analyst

• Review risk data to find risks to cost, schedule, and performance, both in specific areas and across the program.

• Work with the program team to collect and check risk data.

• Keep the risk register current, including the risk, how likely it is, its impact, who owns it, and the plan to reduce it.

• Write and brief risk status for program leadership and the customer, in writing, in charts, and in person.

• Follow mitigation actions until they are closed and report on what risk is left.

• Help manage issues and escalations when a risk actually happens.

• Write the risk sections of weekly and monthly reports and other deliverables.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree.

• Five (5) years of relevant work experience.

• Experience as a Scrum Master for a delivery team.

• Working knowledge of SAFe Lean-Agile principles and practices.

• Experience reviewing risk data and identifying risks to cost, schedule, and performance.

• Experience writing and briefing status reports for leadership.

• Ability to obtain and maintain the required VA background investigation.

Desired Qualifications

• Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), or Professional Scrum Master (PSM).

• PMI-RMP, PMP, or a similar certification.

• Experience supporting VA, VHA, DoD, or other federal health programs.

• Experience on an electronic health record rollout or improvement effort.

• Experience with Jira or Azure DevOps, plus Microsoft 365 and SharePoint.

• Experience with government contract deliverables and reporting.

What Makes Someone Successful Here

• Can run a meeting and keep people moving without being their boss.

• Comfortable working with numbers and data, not just conversations.

• Speaks and writes clearly for technical, clinical, and executive audiences.

• Follows through until roadblocks and risks are actually closed out.

• Sees both what the team is doing today and what the program needs down the road.

description:

You'll translate user and business requirements into clear product specifications, help design and optimize Artist Pages and customer journeys, and support the launch of digital products and experiences across content, commerce, and fan engagement. • Create wireframes, user flows, and product documentation, ensuring features align with business objectives and user needs.

Ability to translate business requirements into functional specifications and work effectively with cross-functional teams.

• Interests: Passion for digital products, consumer technology, music and entertainment, fan communities, and creating intuitive user experiences that solve real customer needs

• Analyze test data, document results, and provide detailed reports to identify defects and areas for improvement.

• Optimize test strategies for efficiency and effectiveness, reducing test time without compromising quality.

• Maintain and calibrate test equipment to ensure precision and reliability.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance testing processes and methodologies.

• Execute testing as required.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronics, Computer, Mechanical Engineering, or related fields

• 5+ years of relevant industry experience with emphasis on manufacturing test and product sustainment.

• Familiarity with Linux, Ubuntu, LabVIEW, and NixOS.

• Experience with contract manufacturers in the testing of PCBA/electronic assemblies. Thorough knowledge of PCBA testing standards and methods.

• Familiarity with electronics test equipment such as power supplies, electronic loads, oscilloscope, function generators, spectrum analyzers, data acquisition and measurement sensors.

• Strong root cause analysis skills of non-conforming hardware.

title: Growth Creative Operations
description:
TL;DR: Lovable's growth marketing runs on creative. The volume, variety, and quality of concepts we put in front of people, and how fast what we learn from them turns into the next round. Your job is to own that loop end to end, constantly iterating on it to achieve the best results against your KPIs.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

- You've run high-volume creative testing on performance marketing and can talk specifically about what you learned, not just what you shipped.

- You use AI tools daily and have built something with them that other people now depend on. A workflow, an agent, an internal tool, a tagging pipeline.

- You have opinions about what makes an ad work and can articulate them well.

- You write well for ads. Briefs, hooks, scripts etc.

- You're comfortable being wrong in public. A lot of tests lose, and the loop only works if we’re all comfortable with that.

- You move fast, but balance that with exceptional craft and know where the balance is.

What you’ll do

You'll be the person who decides what we test, why, and what the results mean. Then you'll build the workflows that turn those answers into hundreds of assets a month without losing the taste that made them work in the first place.

- Own the creative operating system. You run creative ops for performance marketing: intake, briefing, production, QA, launch, and post-mortem. You'll define how the process works and then automate the parts that don't need a human in the loop.

- Be the creative performance decision maker. When we can produce hundreds of creatives, you’ll be the person to judge what we make more of, what gets killed and what to slightly edit. That means holding the creative standard high, and making sure that creatives generated look Lovable.

- Build agentic workflows and keep improving them. You'll design pipelines that generate, adapt, and localise creative at volume, with evals to check quality before anything ships. When a workflow breaks, you diagnose it and help rebuild it.

- Turn performance data, audience insights and product knowledge into concepts. You'll dig into what's actually driving results, hook, format, message, subject, pacing, offer, and separate the signal from the noise a low-spend winner creates.

- Run brainstorms and briefing. You own the rhythm that takes learnings, customer language, competitor moves, product releases, and additional context, and works with the wider team to turn them into briefs.

- Push learnings across the company. What wins on paid usually tells us something about the website, lifecycle emails, App Store listings, and organic content. You'll be the one making sure that reaches the relevant people so we become more informed collectively.

Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

While many consumers have never heard of reinsurance - basically insurance for insurance companies - it is a $500+ billion industry that plays a crucial role in providing coverage for catastrophic events such as earthquakes, hurricanes, floods, and wildfires. At Vellum we are leveraging modern technology, advanced analytics, and machine learning to modernize and advance this industry that is burdened by technology and processes that have been largely unchanged in decades. Our team has deep experience in insurance and transforming antiquated technology in established industries.

We are seeking a high-performing Enterprise Account Executive to drive revenue growth by continuing to introduce Vellum ’s data analytics platform to enterprise insurance and reinsurance customers. You will own the full sales cycle, develop strategic relationships with C-suite and technical buyers, and articulate how Vellum ’s AI-enabled solution delivers transformative value across underwriting, actuarial, operations, and portfolio management.

Go-To-Market Execution

• Create compelling proposals and commercial agreements that reflect customer value and business impact.

Market Intelligence

• Gather competitive insights and communicate market feedback back to internal product partners.

• Advise the leadership team on the strategic direction of go-to-market efforts.

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
About Us

Lupa is building a category defining product the industry has never seen before.

We’re the AI-native operating system for veterinary practices and pet parents, replacing the fragmented, clunky systems vets have tolerated for years with a single intelligent platform for scheduling, client communication, clinical documentation, and AI-driven care guidance. Practices run more efficiently, vets get back to doing what they love, and pet parents feel more connected to their animals’ health than ever.

The traction speaks for itself: one of Europe’s top 100 AI startups with a team of 50 people, 10x growth in twelve months, the UK market leader, and now charging hard into the US and Europe. We have $25M in funding, 2.5M+ pets on the platform, and a buzzing New York office.

This is a rare chance to join a rocket ship at exactly the right moment and we’re looking for exceptional people to help us fly it.

In this role, you will:

- Own the full deployment of Lupa into veterinary practices, from the first kick-off call through to a live, confident team that doesn’t need hand-holding

- Immerse yourself in each practice’s workflows, understand how they actually operate day-to-day, and redesign those workflows around Lupa’s AI-native platform

- Synthesise what you’re hearing in the field, from vets, practice managers, and receptionists into a sharp picture of where the product needs to go next

- Partner with Engineering and Product to translate real-world clinical problems into platform improvements that scale across the entire customer base

- Lead training sessions that drive genuine adoption, not just surface-level sign-offs

- Present deployment outcomes and future roadmaps to stakeholders from practice owners to group-level executives

- Build and deliver demos that win new customers and expand existing ones

- Scope new deployment opportunities as we push into the US and new international markets

Your background looks something like:

- 3+ years in a deployment, implementation, forward deployment, or solutions engineering role ideally at a top tier management consultancy, B2B SaaS or tech company known for complex, high-touch deployments

- A track record of managing multiple concurrent deployments without losing quality, pace, or customer trust

- Comfortable engaging at every level of a customer organisation from the vet on the floor to the CFO in the boardroom

- Some experience with data, scripting, or analytical tools (SQL, Python, or similar) you don’t need to be an engineer, but you need to be able to work alongside one

- Experience in healthcare, veterinary, or another regulated, workflow-heavy industry (nice to have)

- Background at a company known for exceptional deployment quality Palantir, Salesforce, Veeva, or similar (nice to have)

As a person, you:

- Are not satisfied with surface-level answers you dig into the data, the workflow, and the real problem until you actually understand it

- Have low ego, the outcome matters more than who gets the credit, and you’re as comfortable following as you are leading

- Are genuinely curious and analytical, with a sharp instinct for product and a deep interest in how users think and behave

- Thrive in unstructured, ambiguous environments where no two days look the same and the playbook doesn’t exist yet

- Are excited to work in-person from our New York office.

- Value working with people who are kind, ambitious, and pragmatic

What does success look like in 6 months?

- You’re managing a portfolio of deployments independently and every practice you’ve taken live is a genuine Lupa advocate

- The product team trusts your field insight and is already acting on it, you’ve changed at least one roadmap decision

- You’ve helped shape how we deploy as we scale into the US, and your playbook is being used by the rest of the team

Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер - іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти - це ключова цінність SKELAR.

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Зараз ми в пошуку Motion Designer у New Venture.

У світі понад 1,8 мільярда людей вивчають іноземні мови, але менше ніж 10% здатні говорити ними вільно. Ми починаємо будувати середовище інтерактивної комунікації - AI Language Tutor - щоб говорити і робити помилки без страху осуду.

Наша мета - побудувати продукт, що навчатиметься разом з користувачем - збиратиме дані про нього, персоналізувати підхід і мотивувати до нових кроків. Ми не віримо в універсальні підходи до навчання, але знаємо, що алгоритми допоможуть користувачу навчатися in his own way of learning. І (нарешті) результативно.

 

Цей продукт ще потрібно побудувати. Тож якщо будувати щось з нуля - це про тебе, давай робити це разом?

Про роль: ти станеш людиною, яка перетворює ідеї на рух. На етапі від 0 до 1 наш головний канал зростання - це performance-відео, і саме твої креативи будуть тим, що зупиняє скрол і приводить перших користувачів. Ми шукаємо моушн-дизайнера, який мислить не лише красивою анімацією, а й метриками: розуміє, що креатив існує не заради естетики, а заради CTR і конверсії. Ти власноруч закладеш систему виробництва відеоконтенту, яка дозволить нам швидко тестувати десятки гіпотез і масштабувати те, що працює.

Що будеш робити:

- Виробництво performance-креативів: створення моушн-відео під рекламу (з фокусом на Meta) - анімація інтерфейсів, динамічні ролики, кінетична типографіка.

- Робота за сценаріями: реалізація детальних ТЗ та сценаріїв від Creative Marketing Manager - від хука до CTA.

- Швидка ітерація: тісна співпраця з UA та Creative-командою, аналіз ефективності креативів (CTR, CR) і швидке допилювання на основі даних.

- Побудова системи: створення бібліотеки шаблонів, пресетів та асетів, що дозволить виробляти багато варіацій без втрати швидкості та якості.

Що ми очікуємо від тебе:

- Досвід: 2+ років у моушн-дизайні для цифрових продуктів (рівень Middle), із сильним портфоліо саме performance-креативів.

- Технічна експертиза: впевнене володіння Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro); розуміння повного циклу виробництва відео - від раскадровки до фінального рендеру.

- AI-інструменти: практичний досвід роботи з AI-інструментами для генерації відео та графіки (Runway, Kling, Midjourney, Sora, Seedance тощо) для прискорення продакшену та виробництва варіацій.

- Performance-підхід: глибоке розуміння структури рекламного відео (хук, основна частина, CTA) і того, як анімація впливає на утримання уваги та конверсію.

- Швидкість: ти вмієш видавати обсяг і варіативність - десятки ітерацій під тестування гіпотез, а не один ідеальний ролик на місяць.

- Startup Mindset: тебе не лякає відсутність готових брендбуків і процесів - ти будуєш їх сам і береш відповідальність за візуальний результат.

Буде великим плюсом:

- Досвід створення креативів для мобільних застосунків (зокрема з subscription-моделлю).

- Розуміння специфіки EdTech або AI-продуктів.

- Англійська мова: рівень B1+ або вище (для роботи з референсами та аналізу конкурентів).
Готовий(а) вигравати в команді, де кожен підсилює іншого? Чекаємо на тебе!

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
description:
Ready to be a Titan?
We are seeking an experienced Staff Cloud Security Engineer to shape the security foundation of our modern cloud environments and next-generation applications. In this high-impact role, you will design cutting-edge automated security controls, harden multi-cloud infrastructure, and champion secure development practices across the organization. If you are passionate about cloud security, DevSecOps, and staying ahead of emerging threats, this role puts you right at the center of innovation.
What You’ll Do:
DevSecOps and Automation

• Pipeline Integration: Integrate robust security controls directly into CI/CD platforms such as GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.

• Automated Scanning: Evaluate and implement pipeline-based security Infrastructure as Code (IaC) scanning. Manage and configure IaC scanning tools to surface true risk.

• Developer Feedback Loops: Build and optimize developer feedback loops and automated remediation workflows to ensure software is secure by default. Develop automated scripts using Python, Bash, or PowerShell to streamline security processes.

Identity and Access Management (IAM)

• Cloud Identity Controls: Build and maintain IAM security controls across cloud platforms, assessing policies to enforce the principle of least privilege.

• Non-Human Identity Management: Standardize management, security controls, and lifecycle expectations with regard to non-human identity.

• Secrets Management: Govern the secure use of cloud identities, Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), and secrets management.

Infrastructure Security and Hardening

• Cloud Posture: Develop and implement secure infrastructure baselines, vulnerability management processes, and hardening standards across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Validate security configurations and leverage IaC tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep to ensure repeatable, auditable, and secure infrastructure provisioning.

• Network Security: Tackle high-impact infrastructure projects such as multi-cloud network isolation, secure multi-tenant use, and continuous remediation of discovered misconfigurations.

Workload Security

• Cloud-Native Architectures: Guide engineering teams on secure architecture design for cloud apps, microservices, serverless services, and PaaS workloads.

• Container Security: Advance container and Kubernetes security by implementing runtime controls, supply-chain security, and configuration assessments.

• AI & Emerging Tech: Secure in-house and public AI/ML systems against cyber threats, adversarial attacks, and unauthorized access, ensuring models and data pipelines are protected throughout the solution lifecycle.

Data Security and Privacy

• Data Protection: Ensure that sensitive cloud and AI data is properly encrypted, anonymized, and securely stored.

• Encryption Standards: Assess and implement strong encryption configurations, checkpoint encryption, and tokenization to protect data at rest and in transit.

• Compliance Alignment: Develop and enforce policies to align data security and privacy measures with industry regulations, ethical standards, and organizational governance requirements.

Monitoring, Detection, and Response

• Telemetry & Visibility: Partner with Security Operations to improve cloud application telemetry, logging, and observability. Help expand monitoring capabilities by onboarding log sources and building detection rules for cloud-based threats.

• Threat Detection: Monitor and analyze security events using SIEM, Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), and Cloud Workload Protection Platforms (CWPP).

• Incident Response: Support the triage, investigation, and forensic analysis of cloud-based application or pipeline security incidents, working collaboratively to contain and mitigate threats.

What You’ll Bring:

• Experience: 7-10+ years of hands-on experience in cloud security, application security, DevSecOps, or related engineering ro

title: AI SDLC Trainer and Change Lead
description:
At Electric Mind, Engineering is where strategy meets action. Our team helps organizations cut through complexity-aligning business ambition with technology execution to unlock real, lasting change. You’ll work alongside curious, driven people tackling high-impact challenges for everyone from scaling startups to global enterprises. Each engagement is different, pushing you to learn, adapt, and grow.  
 
Electric Mind’s Technology Practice brings together deep engineering expertise, modern delivery disciplines, and pragmatic architectural thinking to help clients execute complex, mission-critical transformation. We design and implement scalable, secure, high-impact technology solutions that accelerate business outcomes.  
About the Role
The Training & Change Lead is accountable for the training and change management work on an assigned client project. That project’s commitments are the primary commitment.
You review the training and change components of the project SOW (statement of work), advise on the work required to meet those commitments, work with the People team and project leadership to staff trainers to scope and budget, and make sure the required content is available. You create and tailor project content unless that work can be delegated to staff trainers. You remain accountable for quality and innovation on this project.
You may create or maintain reusable training resources that other Electric Mind projects can use only when that work does not put this project’s deliverables at risk. You are not accountable for Electric Mind-wide internal training for staff who are not on this project.

About Electric Mind 
 
Electric Mind is a fast-growing, AI-native advisory and digital engineering firm built for those who want to shape the future, not just watch it happen. We blend premium strategy expertise with cutting-edge AI-centric engineering to solve complex, meaningful problems for industry-leading clients.  
 
We pride ourselves on a high-touch delivery model and a culture that values diverse talent, innovation, and true client partnership - creating an environment where your ideas matter and your impact is visible.  
If you’re looking for a place where you can grow fast, collaborate with exceptional teammates, and help build a company scaling its capabilities and global footprint at speed - Electric Mind is the place to ignite your career. The future is bright! 
 
For more info on Electric Mind, check out our Careers Page and Instagram.
 
Electric Mind is committed to diversity in the workplace. We are an inclusive employer and welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates. Applicants’ needs will be accommodated during our recruitment and selection process so please advise us if you require accommodation.

title: C3 Presents - Financial Analyst
description:
Job Summary:
WHO ARE WE?
Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit .
C3 Presents creates music festival experiences for millions of fans across the globe, setting the new standard each year for events that are as memorable as they are spectacular, including Austin City Limits Music Festival in Texas, Lollapalooza in Chicago (and seven other countries), and Bonnaroo in Manchester, Tennessee.
WHO ARE YOU?
Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment , our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!
THE JOB
The Financial Analyst supports financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and operational analysis across C3 Presents' festivals, events, and business operations. This role partners with Finance, Accounting, Sponsorship, Legal, Operations, and other business teams to provide accurate financial reporting, insightful analysis, and decision support.
The Financial Analyst is responsible for maintaining financial models, preparing forecasts and reports, analyzing business performance, and supporting budgeting processes. This position plays an important role in ensuring the accuracy of financial information while identifying trends, risks, and opportunities that support sound business decisions.
WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO
Financial Planning & Analysis

• Assist with the preparation of monthly forecasts, annual operating budgets, long-range planning, and Capital Expenditure Requests (CERs).

• Prepare financial reports and analyze variances between actual results, forecasts, budgets, and prior periods.

• Maintain financial models, forecasting schedules, dashboards, and management reporting.

• Monitor forecast accuracy and recommend improvements to planning assumptions.

• Analyze revenue and expense activity to identify trends and investigate reporting discrepancies.

• Maintain financial tracking schedules and supporting business reports.

Process Improvement

• Identify opportunities to improve financial reporting processes, forecasting accuracy, and operational efficiency.

• Support implementation of reporting enhancements and process improvements.

• Assist with audit requests, reporting requirements, and financial documentation.

Reporting & Analysis

• Prepare recurring and ad hoc financial analyses for management.

• Develop reporting packages and dashboards that support departmental decision-making.

• Support additional finance projects and responsibilities as assigned.

• Perform additional duties and projects as assigned
WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related field.

• 3-5 years of experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), financial analysis, business analytics, or corporate finance.

• Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including financial modeling and data analysis.

• Experience with Oracle, SAP, Hyperion, Adaptive Planning, or similar ERP and forecasting systems preferred.

• Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

title: Product Manager, Supply Chain Systems
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a systems-minded procurement professional who thrives in a rapidly evolving environment. The Procurement Operations Lead will partner with stakeholders to optimize our ERP environments, building scalable workflows. This role will continue to evolve alongside advancements in AI and automation within the company.

AT APPLIED INTUITION, YOU WILL:

- Own product direction for the systems and data that run the end-to-end supply chain

- Turn a complex map of supply chain elements into clear data models and specs

- Define and own the workflows and product surfaces for all supplier management mechanisms

- Define and own the workflows and product surfaces for logistics and trade compliance

- Partner with IT on technical tradeoffs and system design

- Work with Supply Chain, Finance, IT, Legal, Program Management, Engineering, Business, and Operations to understand each domain and validate what you build against real workflows

- Define and track the metrics that prove the product is creating leverage

- Identify where AI and automation should replace manual process

WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS:

- 7+ years of supply chain systems experience, ideally on data, platform, workflow, or internal tools

- Ability to work with IT on technical tradeoffs and reason independently about system and data model design

- Strong written communication: crisp requirements, clear prioritization rationale, and a documented point of view

- Comfort with ambiguity and a track record of defining structure where none existed

- Demonstrated ability to ship products with measurable operational impact

- Experience with ERP or MRP systems in a supply chain or finance context; familiarity with NetSuite and Zip

- Fluency working directly in underlying data and tables

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

NICE TO HAVE:

- Exposure to supply chain, manufacturing, procurement, or logistics operations, whether as a PM or an operator

- Diverse background supporting both hardware and software products

- Familiarity with trade compliance, including customs, export controls, and ITAR-regulated programs

- Experience building LLM-powered applications or agentic workflows

- Experience in a rapidly evolving startup or high-growth technology environment

Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401

title: Vertriebsinnendienst (x/f/m)
description:
WERDE TEIL UNSERER MISSION, WERDE TEIL VON DOCTOLIB!

Du willst die Digitalisierung des Gesundheitswesens aktiv vorantreiben - und gleichzeitig in einem Umfeld arbeiten, in dem deine Vertriebsstärke, dein Ehrgeiz und dein Lernwille wirklich etwas bewegen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Unser Inside-Sales-Team übernimmt eine zentrale Aufgabe: Wir helfen unseren Bestandskund:innen (Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams), das volle Potenzial von Doctolib auszuschöpfen - und bieten ihnen Lösungen an, die echten Mehrwert und messbaren Impact schaffen.

Wenn du hungrig bist, gern Verantwortung übernimmst und Spaß daran hast, über Telefon und Video Upselling-Potenziale zu heben, dann bewirb dich jetzt!

DEINE AUFGABEN

- Du bist für den aktiven Vertrieb unseres Doctolib-KI-Assistenten (Telefonassistent und Sprechstundenassistent) an bestehende Kund:innen verantwortlich - inklusive strukturierter und proaktiver Ansprache.

- Du führst zielgerichtete, empathische und effiziente Gespräche: Du verstehst Bedürfnisse, identifizierst Herausforderungen und präsentierst relevante Lösungen.

- Du steuerst den gesamten Sales-Zyklus selbstständig - vom Erstkontakt über Beratung, Angebotserstellung und Einwandbehandlung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.

- Du arbeitest hochstrukturiert und KPI-orientiert: Du trackst deine Pipeline, misst deinen Fortschritt, nutzt Feedback aktiv und entwickelst dich kontinuierlich weiter.

- Du dokumentierst deine Aktivitäten und Ergebnisse in Salesforce und leistest so einen direkten Beitrag zu unserem Umsatzwachstum.

- Du arbeitest eng mit Customer Success, Marketing und weiteren Teams zusammen, um Kundenerlebnisse ganzheitlich zu optimieren.

DEIN PROFIL

Auch wenn du nicht alles zu 100 % erfüllst - wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Entscheidend sind Motivation und Mindset.

Das bringst du mit

- Begeisterung für telefonischen Vertrieb und proaktive Kund:innenansprache - idealerweise Erfahrung im Upsell oder Cross-Sell.

- Hohe intrinsische Motivation: Du arbeitest zielorientiert, misst dich gern an KPI und bleibst ambitioniert - auch an herausfordernden Tagen.

- Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit verbunden mit hoher Empathie: Du kannst vertrauensvolle Beziehungen aufbauen und komplexe Informationen klar vermitteln.

- Strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise: Du behältst den Überblick über Pipeline, Prioritäten und Prozesse.

- Lernbereitschaft und Offenheit für Feedback - du willst jeden Tag ein Stück besser werden.

- Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Interesse an digitalen Innovationen im Gesundheitswesen.

BESONDERS INTERESSANT FÜR UNS

- Erste Erfahrung im Inside Sales, Telesales oder in der aktiven Betreuung von Bestandskund:innen ist ein Plus - Quereinsteiger:innen sind willkommen, wenn sie Drive und Lernhunger mitbringen.

- Abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung.

• Translate ambiguous mandates from IT leadership into structured, trackable programs with clear owners and success criteria.

• Serve as the coordination layer for high-impact, cross-functional programs - working in lockstep with engineering leaders and teams, ensuring dependencies are visible and delivery stays on track.

title: Agent Standards Specialist, Global Affairs
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We believe that achieving our goal requires effective engagement with public policy stakeholders and the broader community impacted by AI. Accordingly, our Global Affairs team builds authentic, collaborative relationships with public officials and the broader AI policymaking community to inform and support our shared work in these domains. We ensure that insights from policymakers inform our work and - in collaboration with our colleagues and external stakeholders - seek to shape policy so that it aligns with and supports our mission.

About the Role

As AI agents move from answering questions to taking action across the internet, the standards that govern identity, delegated authority, discovery, communications, agentic-commerce and payment interfaces, agent-facing web access, agent-specific provenance, and auditability will determine whether agents can operate safely, interoperably, and with clear accountability. OpenAI is looking for an Agent Standards Manager to lead execution of our external technical standards strategy for a defined set of agent standards workstreams.

This role will work closely with Agent Security, Applied and Platform teams, Product, Legal, GRC, Global Affairs, and GTM to turn OpenAI’s technical architecture and controls into credible specifications, protocol profiles, assurance criteria, and implementation guidance-and to bring emerging external requirements back into product and security roadmaps before they become blockers. The positions developed here are technical standards positions, not broad public-policy positions.

This is a builder’s role as much as an external-facing role. You will execute a prioritized standards plan, author and negotiate protocols, build coalitions, secure the right internal approvals, and represent OpenAI in assigned technical forums. You will also help create repeatable processes that let the company shape agent standards without depending on a single person or relying on technical teams to carry external standards work on top of their core jobs.

The Agent Standards Manager is an integrator, not the owner of every underlying technical system. Security, Product, Engineering, and other designated technical teams retain ownership of architecture, threat models, controls, product decisions, approvals, and implementation. This role owns workstream planning, standards translation, drafting, negotiation, external representation within approved mandates, commitment traceability, and implementation handoff.

In this role, you will:

- Own a focused workstream plan for core agent identity, discovery, and delegated-authorization standards, with adjacent agentic-commerce, web-access, provenance, and auditability work assigned through portfolio prioritization.

- Recommend where OpenAI should lead, shape, monitor, oppose, or decline to participate within the assigned workstream, based on technical maturity, governance quality, strategic leverage, implementation readiness, and company priorities.

- Develop technical standards positions and normative contributions that preserve distinctions among the human or service principal, agent, workload or runtime, task, session, resource, and policy decision.

- Shape requirements for scoped delegation, attenuation, step-up approval, revocation, credential custody, runtime binding, discovery, interoperability, agent-specific provenance, and auditable action trails.

- Embed with Agent Security and Applied or Platform teams to translate internal architecture and controls into technically credible specifications, profiles, white papers, and assurance evidence without overstating maturity or deployment status.

- Lead review and approval paths across Product, Security, Engineering, Legal, GRC, Global Affairs, and GTM; maintain clear mandates, red lines, owners, dependencies, and external commitments.
